items.statement: The independent search validates stationary points and assigns the reaction-coordinate mode to each accepted channel candidate.
items.expected: Both channels have candidate-specific frequency and connectivity evidence, or a scientifically explicit bounded failure.

items.statement: The investigation records hypotheses, candidate identities, deduplication/advancement decisions and a stopping rule.
items.expected: The report makes independent search coverage auditable and does not assert exhaustive discovery without support.

items.statement: The source bulk model gives 47.5 kJ/mol for aminolysis and 43.4 kJ/mol for alcoholysis.
items.expected: Independent computed values are compared to these source values, while preserving the agent's own method and uncertainty.
